## Summary of the Pull Request

This PR fix file preview pane flickering issues in the File Explorer Addon for MonacoPreview, SvgPreview and MarkdownPreview. These previews utilize WebView2, which has been causing the flickering issues. The problems occur during file selection and resizing the file preview pane.

To address these issues, the PR applies [a fix from the Peek module](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/26342/files), following the suggestion of @crutkas. This fix flickering after the file preview loading screen is removed and before the file content is displayed (refer to the blue flickering [in the video](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/assets/26683979/11df11b4-affb-49a1-8a31-396c0d150588)). However, it does not fix the flickering that when the user changes file selection or resizes the file preview pane. Because the flickering is not related to the WebView2 background color, as it occurs before the WebView is created.

To resolve the remaining issues, two modifications were made. Firstly, the background color was set for the parent window (fix green flickering [in the video](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/assets/26683979/11df11b4-affb-49a1-8a31-396c0d150588)). Secondly, the background color was set in the form, after invoking the handler executable (fix red flickering [in the video](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/assets/26683979/11df11b4-affb-49a1-8a31-396c0d150588)).

Other things fixed
- Use Color.FromArgb instead of ColorTranslator.FromHtml for improved performance ([dotnetfiddle](https://dotnetfiddle.net/k2CoiR)), put hex color codes in comment. https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/26660/commits/e89a4f6c12a9119debe7c4c2cab41b9b9fd0e654

<!-- Describe how you validated the behavior. Add automated tests wherever possible, but list manual validation steps taken as well -->
## Validation Steps Performed

For the modules I changed, I done following steps for validation
1. Built the .MSI installer and installed it
2. Manual testing, I observe if my changes fix flickering on file selection and while resizing file preview pane.
3. File selection test: I select multiple files repeatedly and select the files then select folder repeatedly
4. File preview pane resizing test: I resize the pane slowly and rapidly to check for any flickering
5. Tested theme switching by switching between Light and Dark modes, as well as transitioning from Dark to Light and vice versa. To ensured the styles adjusted correctly based on the selected theme.
6. Tested my changes on different machines running Windows 11 and Windows 10.
